headline: Japan to allocate $7 billion to subsidize retail gasoline prices
summary: The Japanese government decided to tap $7 billion from contingency reserves to continue capping retail gasoline prices amid soaring oil and fuel import costs, while planning to scale back support from December.
why: Government fuel subsidies directly impact domestic energy costs, fiscal outlays, and short-term inflationary pressures in major economies.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: Government fiscal action directly impacts domestic energy markets and national reserves.
